implemented.heading: Persistent movement client accepts relative orientation or absolute IMU heading. Execution-time anchor, shortest route, exact antipode left, <=0.35rad/s,0.05rad tolerance,0.3s distinct capture-time dwell, hard timeout. Physical angle accuracy unaccepted.
implemented.heading_verification: Distinct fresh applied observations must match a causally earlier requested command within0.2s and existing0.02 component tolerance. This is bounded compatibility, not measured transport latency. Zero confirmation remains separate.
implemented.tactics: Explicit expiring auto intent selects offense/defense per robot. External intents replace ownership; no auto fallback on lease loss. Defender preserves facing toward ball while repositioning.
implemented.referee: Nonzero goal pulses latch only after whole valid frame admission, including holds without motion authority. Every action yields to goal return before target lookup.
implemented.resume: Explicit session-checked per-robot resume references exact current field frame, completed return, correct home position/heading, cleared goal, current lease and clear configured camera. No queued reset or renewed authority.
implemented.software_start: Resident helper and session Start freeze a challenge at actual input receipt. No discovery wait, newer-status repair, automatic retry or homing. Initial ordinary Stop may release; subsequent Stop epoch/gateway instance changes end session. Pending/uncertain exit requests emergency Stop. Real ROS integration passed three groups against the actual gateway and a fake controller backend.
implemented.camera_body_guard: Actual-command guard candidate reuses ForwardObstacleGate after the existing mux. Rejects invalid/stale evidence, all axes held on obstacle, requires post-hold upstream zero before fresh motion, fences producer restart. Fixed-anchor source-clock mapping reserves50ms within350ms deadline (~300ms stable-clock capture age). Optional manifest roles now select guarded routing; stock defaults unchanged. Candidate not deployed.
implemented.camera_producer: Same inference publishes original capture stamp, per-process UUID, sequence, fixed geometry and explicit validity. Fixed0.4 detector confidence; display confidence/rotation/color do not modify detector input or published evidence. Startup --swap-rb configures detector color.
implemented.camera_cadence: Viewer now uses phase-preserving monotonic admission. On490 recorded timestamps, scheduling replay without inference admitted299 frames before versus490 after. This is scheduling evidence only; actual Hailo inference/capture age still unmeasured. Stalls discard missed slots without backlog.
implemented.guarded_session: Guard process continuity and named publisher graph are separate from native manager authority. Ordinary camera hold cancels finite action, revokes prepare token and keeps client resident after verified zero. Fresh prepare/run required after clearance. Guard-only loss exits client without deactivating healthy native standing. Native fault, pending/uncertain Start or explicit Stop during cancellation retains emergency precedence.
